observations: Photo 0: White Canon DSLR body with a white kit zoom lens, lens cap on, held in hand against a tiled floor background; 'Canon' logo visible on lens cap and body.
Photo 1: Rear view of the same white Canon body; LCD screen appears black/off, viewfinder, MENU/INFO buttons, Av, SET dial, playback and trash icons visible; 'Canon' logo printed below screen.
Photo 2: Close-up of top/front of body showing 'Canon' logo and a partially obscured model badge that reads ambiguously as 'EOS 100D' or 'EOS 1000D' (text is blurry and partly cut off by hand/angle).
No shots of a power-on screen, serial number plate, battery compartment, memory card slot, included accessories (battery, charger, strap, box), or the camera actually focusing/zooming.
Watermark 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD' and 'Posted on Jiji' overlay all three photos; no other listing context visible.

identity.kind: DSLR camera with kit zoom lens

claims.evidence: Photo 2 shows a model badge that is blurry/obscured; it could read '100D' or '1000D', which are very different cameras in price and spec. No clear, well-lit, unobstructed shot of the badge is provided.
No sensor spec, menu screen, or EXIF/photo sample shown in any image.

risks.risk: Model confusion between EOS 100D (higher-end, newer, pricier) and EOS 1000D (older, much lower-value entry DSLR) based on ambiguous badge text in photo 2.
risks.proof: A sharp, well-lit, straight-on close-up of the model badge/nameplate on the front of the body, unobstructed by fingers.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as the lower-value model (EOS 1000D) until the badge is clearly confirmed as 100D.

risks.risk: LCD screen appears black/off in photo 1 — could indicate a dead or faulty screen rather than just being powered off.
risks.proof: A photo or short video of the camera powered on showing the screen displaying a live image or menu.

risks.risk: Lens and autofocus functionality not demonstrated — no evidence of zoom, focus, or image capture working.
risks.proof: A short video showing the lens zooming, autofocus engaging, and a sample photo taken.

risks.risk: Unknown accessory completeness (battery, charger, strap, box, memory card) which affects resale value.
risks.proof: A photo of all included accessories laid out together with the camera.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body and lens only, no accessories.

risks.risk: Shutter count/sensor wear and overall mechanical condition cannot be assessed from exterior photos alone.
risks.proof: A photo of the camera's menu shutter count screen or a sample full-resolution image showing sensor dust/spots.
risks.if_unproven: Priced assuming high shutter count / unknown sensor condition.

proof_requests: Clear, unobstructed, well-lit close-up of the model nameplate/badge on the front of the camera body.
Photo or video of the camera powered on with the LCD screen displaying a live view or menu.
Video of the lens zooming and autofocusing, plus one sample photo taken with it.
Photo of all included accessories (battery, charger, strap, memory card, box).
Photo of the in-camera shutter count screen (via menu) or a sample image showing sensor condition.
response.reason: The core identity claim (EOS 100D vs a visually similar but very different EOS 1000D) cannot be confirmed from the blurry badge in photo 2, and this model distinction drives the price tier; a readable close-up of the nameplate is needed before even a worst-case price can be set.
